p: month shall be unto you the: Called Nisan, containing part of March and part of April.
month of the year to you: Concerning the observation of feasts: as for other policies, they reckoned from September.
fathers: As the fathers of the household had great or small families.
eating shall make your count for: He will take as many as are needed to eat the lamb.
whole assembly of the congregation of: Every one his house.
head with his legs: That is, all that may be eaten.
it is the LORD'S passover: The lamb was not the Passover, but signified it, as ordinances are not the thing itself which they represent, but rather they signify it.
memorial: Of the benefits received for your deliverance.
for ever: That is, until Christ's coming: for then ceremonies will end.
even: For in ancient times they counted in this way, beginning the day at sunset till the next day at the same time.
destroyer to come in unto your: The angel sent by God to kill the first born.
land which the LORD will give: The land of Canaan.
bowed the head and worshipped: They gave God thanks for so great a benefit.
not a house where there was: Of these houses, in which any first born lived, either of men of beasts.
bless me also: Pray for me.
Rameses to Succoth: Which was a city in Goshen; Ge 47:11.
a mixed multitude went up also: Which were strangers, and not born from the Israelites.
four hundred and thirty years: From Abraham's departing from Ur in Chaldea to the departing of the children of Israel from Egypt are 430 years.
There shall no stranger eat thereof: Unless he is circumcised, and professes your religion only.
law shall be to him that: They that are of the household of God, must be all joined in one faith and religion.
